summary: Full liveness and branding pass (backend + frontend). BACKEND: 13/14 new tests pass (tests/test_iter31_blindspot_live.py). _live shows relay 'on' with 0 errors. indexer stats returned 1256-1259 leaves and 325 nullifiers. The assets list is non-empty and includes SOL. /api/ds source tokens include SOL with an id; destination term=USDC returns USDC on many chains; quotes for SOL to USDC (Solana) return 8 routes. All 5 _brand assets return 200, and the manifest name contains BlindSpot. /app/ HTML is clean. The one failure: the vault HTML still contains 'Omni' in its og/twitter meta tags. FRONTEND: Landing page passes. hero-title is present; hero-notes counts up (283 to 1,259); all 8 tool discs have correct hrefs; pillars, quantum, flow, fees and fees-table sections exist; the FAQ accordion opens; why-dialog opens and closes; nav-x-follow goes to x.com/tryblind. At 390px the mobile menu shows all discs and there is no horizontal scroll. /app passes: full-screen splash, Vault tab by default, all 5 vz-flow tabs switch views and update aria-selected, and nc-pitch-connect opens the 'Create account.' modal. Wallet order is BlindSpot vault, then Phantom; vz-more-wallets reveals Solflare and Backpack. vz-x-follow opens an x.com/tryblind popup. vz-menu-btn opens #nc-sheet with all 11 tiles. Private route loads tokens and gave a live SOL to USDC (Solana) quote (0.5 SOL = 51.85 USDC, 3 routes, fees and limits shown). Privacy swap shows the Confidential Intents banner, Track renders, and Chain shows the .ch-term LIVE feed. Deep links ?do=send, swap, withdraw and shield open the matching tab; bridge and receive also work. Vault creation works with password BlindTest#2026x: the recovery key starts with blindsk2, the Receive address with blind2, and the view-only key with blindvk1. History (#activity), Keys and Addresses views render. No console errors and no /api 4xx/5xx in the app. /vault shows the 'Vault.' heading and the iframe loads the quantum vault UI. /docs has all Protocol research links, and #quantum / #quantum-vault scroll correctly. Branding scan of visible text, titles and alt/aria/title/placeholder on /, /docs, /vault outer page, /app and all 14 /app views found no banned names. The vault iframe does contain 'omni' (details below).

minor.issue: The HTML still has upstream brand meta tags: og:title and twitter:title 'Omni — Everywhere. Unseen.', og:site_name 'Omni', og:image:alt 'omni. Everywhere. Unseen...', twitter:site '@omnizec', and og.jpg is the upstream image. These show up in link previews. The theme-color is light (#e5e6e5).

The upstream (darkswap.app/api/swap/quotes) sometimes returns 404 {"error":"Not found"} on the first request for a given amount or pair. In one sample 4 of 6 calls failed, called both through our proxy and directly. Retrying usually returns 200. The proxy's RETRY_STATUS does not include 404, so the user could briefly see a 'Not found' quote error. In the UI run the first quote returned 200.

issues: BRANDING LEAK: after expanding 'What this protects, and what it does not', the visible text reads '...so omni saves each signed withdrawal and sends only that one until it lands.'

These strings are also in the vault DOM and appear in other vault states or settings: button 'omni' and aria 'Omni home', 'RPC: omni', 'this page reads Solana through omni’s server', 'Still through omni’s server', 'THE POINT OF OMNI', 'Omni brings private payments...', 'omni wallet', and the X link 'Omni on X, @omnizec'. _vault_rewrite in bifrost.py (~line 487) only replaces 'omni vault', 'omni included' and '© OMNI'.
The iframe content is a light cream theme (#f4f6ee), but the brief says dark only. This may be intentional; please confirm.
?do=bridge sends the user to /app#nullswap. The upstream 'null' naming shows in the URL bar. Consider aliasing it to #bridge.

The header pill shows 'BlindSpot Wallet · Cu9b…mGxw' while the balance card shows 'BlindSpot Wallet C4WZ…6W7d'. Two different addresses with the same label is confusing; label one of them, e.g. 'Deposit address'.

Seen once: in a screenshot taken right after a programmatic scroll to the FAQ, the fixed header (background rgba(0,0,0,0)) showed fees-section text through the nav links. After the scroll settled, the nav had a dark band. Low priority.

action_items: Vault mirror branding: in _vault_rewrite (JS branch), replace the remaining visible lowercase and uppercase 'omni' strings ("so omni saves", "omni’s server", "RPC: omni", "THE POINT OF OMNI", "Omni brings", "omni wallet", 'Omni home', 'Omni on X, @omnizec'). Only change visible strings, not identifiers.
Vault HTML: rewrite or remove the og:* and twitter:* meta tags (title, site_name, image:alt, twitter:site @omnizec, og.jpg) to BlindSpot values.
Optional: add retry-on-404 (2-3 tries, short backoff) for the /api/ds/quotes path in server.py _ds_request to absorb the upstream's intermittent 404 on first quote.
Optional: alias #nullswap to #bridge; clarify the two different 'BlindSpot Wallet' addresses.

Stale regression tests: test_iter33_app_umbra.py::test_manifest_vaulz, test_no_nullcash[nc-theme.css] (that file is now inlined, so /_brand/nc-theme.css returns 404 by design) and test_iter31_vault.py title/'Vaulz zk' assertions still expect the old Vaulz brand. Update them to BlindSpot or delete them.
critical_code_review_comments: bifrost.py _vault_rewrite does exact-case replacements on a few phrases. The upstream uses 'omni', 'Omni' and 'OMNI' in many visible strings, so a case-aware word-boundary replace limited to visible text, or a strings map like brand/_strings.json, would hold up better.

Writing files under /app/backend/tests triggers a uvicorn --reload, which resets the in-memory _LIVE relay counters (ok goes back to 0 right after a test file is saved). This only happens in dev, but tests should not assert ok>0.

success_rate.backend: 93% (13/14; only the vault meta-tag brand check fails)
success_rate.frontend: 97% (all flows work; only the vault iframe 'omni' branding leak)
